items.criterion: The health route answers 200 once the database and the object store are reachable.
items.judgment: Call the health route from outside the container and read the status.

items.criterion: All four seeded accounts sign in with the corpus password and receive a token carrying their role.
items.judgment: Post each seeded email with the pinned password and read the returned role.

items.criterion: The public story endpoint returns the three published stories and omits the other three.
items.judgment: Read the story endpoint anonymously and compare the public id set with the seed.

items.criterion: The photograph route refuses an anonymous caller for a story that is not public.
items.judgment: Request the photograph of the scheduled story with no token and read the status.

items.criterion: The photograph route refuses a signed-in visitor for a story that is not public.
items.judgment: Request the same photograph with a visitor token and read the status.

items.criterion: The photograph route serves the stored bytes to a signed-in editor.
items.judgment: Request the same photograph with an editor token and read the body length.

items.criterion: An uploaded photograph becomes a real object in the bucket under the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Upload a photograph as a contributor and list the bucket for the key the story reports.

items.criterion: A story created in the workspace starts in the draft state and stays out of the public list.
items.judgment: Create a story as a contributor, then read the public list anonymously.

items.criterion: Publishing a story adds it to the public list and raises the public count by one.
items.judgment: Read the count, publish, read the count again.

items.criterion: Publishing is refused while a photograph on the story carries no alternative text.
items.judgment: Upload a photograph without alternative text and call publish as an editor.

items.criterion: A story create issued from a visitor session is refused at the API.
items.judgment: Post a story with a visitor token and read the status.

items.criterion: An ingestion run replayed under the same identifier applies nothing the second time.
items.judgment: Submit one run twice and read the duplicate flag and the applied count.

items.criterion: A classification carrying an older provider instant never replaces the stored result.
items.judgment: Ingest a final classification, then a stale one, then read the stored position.

items.criterion: A field carrying an active manual override survives a clashing ingestion run.
items.judgment: Record an override, submit a clashing run, then read the stored value.

items.criterion: A subscription is pending until its own token confirms the address.
items.judgment: Subscribe, read the status, confirm with the returned token, read the status again.

items.criterion: A stored enquiry returns a reference in the ENQ form and the same reference appears in the workspace inbox.
items.judgment: Post an enquiry, then read the inbox with an editor token.

items.criterion: The route grounds alternate between the light neutral family and the true black, with one undiluted lime accent.
items.judgment: Open the home route and the calendar route and decide whether a second accent family appears.

items.criterion: The calendar carries two view modes and the mode is reflected in the address.
items.judgment: Switch between the list and the visualiser and watch the address change.

items.criterion: Headings reveal line by line on a wipe from the left rather than arriving at rest.
items.judgment: Load the home route and watch the statement heading enter.

items.criterion: Keyboard navigation reaches every calendar row with a visible focus ring.
items.judgment: Tab through the calendar list and watch the ring move.
